## v1.5.0

### Features

- update TabLayout to use OFF_BAR for hidden screens and enhance index imports (3bd5114)

### Refactoring

- remove APK installation and update checking logic (00b533d)

### Other

- Remove obsolete OTA and versioning scripts, along with APK update handling and device registration logic (763ce98)

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mark-judah/upande-quality/compare/v1.4.4...v1.5.0

**Release type:** APK (reason: native code changed, so this release starts a new runtime (phones on the old one never get this JS); files that need an APK changed (eas.json, patches/expo-updates+58.0.18.patch, plugins/withBuildTuning.js) - these need a new APK, so one is built; the runtime changes from 1.4 to 1.5)

---

> **Debug-signed build.** This APK is signed with Android's public debug
> key, not a private upload key. Sideload it (you may need to allow
> "Install unknown apps"); it cannot be published to Google Play, and
> it will not install over a build signed with a different key.
